permits.why_needed: Required for all large industrial projects under EIA Notification; basis for construction and operation
permits.required_inputs: EIA report, site selection report, public hearing minutes, NOC from state pollution board

permits.why_needed: Required before construction under Water and Air Acts from State Pollution Control Board
permits.required_inputs: Environmental clearance, site plan, process description, emission inventory, wastewater details

permits.why_needed: Required before commercial operation under Water and Air Acts
permits.required_inputs: CTE, commissioning report, emission test results, wastewater analysis

permits.why_needed: Covers stack emissions from gasifier, reformer, flare, thermal oxidiser, boiler, and DG sets
permits.required_inputs: Stack emission monitoring report, dispersion modelling study, pollution control equipment details

permits.why_needed: Required for generation, storage, and disposal of hazardous wastes (spent catalyst, used oil, filter media, chemical waste)
permits.required_inputs: Hazardous waste inventory, storage facility details, disposal agreement with TSDF

permits.why_needed: Methanol is classified as a hazardous chemical under the Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemicals Rules
permits.required_inputs: Storage tank design drawings, layout, safety study (QRA, HAZOP), fire protection system details

permits.why_needed: Fire safety approval for methanol storage, process area, and buildings covered under fire prevention and life safety regulations
permits.required_inputs: Fire protection philosophy, fire water demand calculation, layout, hydrant/spray system design
permits.evidence_required: Fire NOC from state fire department

permits.why_needed: Registration under Factories Act for manufacturing facility
permits.required_inputs: Factory plan, process description, manpower details, safety equipment list

permits.why_needed: Registration under Boiler Act and Indian Boiler Regulations (or equivalent) for steam boilers and pressure vessels
permits.required_inputs: Vessel design calculation, IBR drawings, material test certificates, NDT reports

permits.why_needed: Approval from Chief Electrical Inspector for high-voltage installation (above 33kV or as per state rules)
permits.required_inputs: Single-line diagram, load list, protection coordination study, earthing layout, cable schedule

permits.why_needed: May require local authority permits for biomass storage (fire risk, odour, pest control) and truck movements
permits.required_inputs: Storage site plan, fire prevention measures, dust control plan, traffic management plan
permits.evidence_required: Local authority approval for storage yard

permits.why_needed: Disposal of gasifier ash/char may require authorisation if classified as hazardous or non-hazardous waste
permits.required_inputs: Ash characterisation report, disposal site agreement, transportation plan

permits.why_needed: Required for groundwater abstraction or surface water withdrawal above prescribed limits
permits.required_inputs: Hydrogeological study, water balance, abstraction point details, NOC from water authority

permits.why_needed: CGWA clearance or equivalent for groundwater extraction for industrial use
permits.required_inputs: Groundwater impact assessment, recharge plan, water balance

permits.why_needed: Approval of building/structural plans from local municipal or development authority
permits.required_inputs: Building plans, structural design, fire compliance, parking, green area compliance

permits.why_needed: Oxygen cylinders, hydrogen cylinders, or other compressed gas storage may require explosives licence
permits.required_inputs: Storage details, PESO application, site safety plan

permits.why_needed: Compliance with noise limits for industrial areas; may require specific permit for high-noise operations
permits.required_inputs: Noise modelling study, noise control measures, compliance with ambient noise standards

permits.why_needed: Import of pressure vessels, catalysts, and specialised equipment requires customs clearance and may need certification
permits.required_inputs: Bill of lading, packing list, invoice, certificate of origin (for green/gHG certification)

permits.why_needed: For green methanol certification under ISCC, RSB, or equivalent scheme; biomass must demonstrate sustainable sourcing
permits.required_inputs: Feedstock supplier sustainability declaration, mass balance calculation, chain of custody documentation

permits.why_needed: Approval of fixed fire fighting systems (hydrants, sprinklers, foam, deluge) by fire authority
permits.required_inputs: Fire water system design, pump capacity calculations, hydrant coverage drawings, foam system details
